participation.context: Wrote the opening, and left the how for later.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You set the heat and the blood, left him jesting, and did not write the wound on this leaf.
topics: the how not on this leaf

title: Wrote the mad blood line and left him jesting

participation.context: Wrote the how, struck the extra, and put the thought away.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Has the part. He was not told.
participation.name: Augustine Phillips

story.body: You put the death down small, gave him eight lines, and struck them. You left the short curse standing, and you did not write the name you had thought of.

title: Wrote the wound, and took the eight lines back

participation.context: Held the pen. His face is not in it.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You kept the stroke visible and the face out of the picture.

title: Looked at the eight struck lines, pen in hand

description: I didn't know it would be him

participation.context: Spoke it standing, and stayed in the room.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: the best part, dead by three, and not yet said to him

story.body: You spoke the July line and the fear of Phillips. You did not take either sentence to him.

relations.note: the best part, dead by three, and not yet said to him

title: Said the best part is dead by three
